subject: How to connect points in a plot?

messages.author: fd010b44b4f0487b
messages.subject: How to connect points in a plot?
parts:
Dear All,

I have a variable which is a factor and another variable which is
numeric(discrete).
I want to plot those two and connect the points with lines.
Is there anyway to do it?
I made a example
a <- as.factor(1:5)
b <- 6:10
data<- data.frame(a = a, b= b)
qplot(a, b, data) + geom_line()

In this case geom_line() doesn't work. Is there anyway for
geom_line() to work?

Thanks,

messages.author: 5196f936ff792c35
messages.subject: Re: How to connect points in a plot?
parts:
I've noticed this too. Geom Line doesn't connect lines between factors. 

If you treat them as numeric... it works. 

a <- as.numeric(1:5)

b <- 6:10
data<- data.frame(a = a, b= b)
qplot(a, b, data) + geom_line()

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: How to connect points in a plot?
parts:
This is because of the way that grouping works in ggplot2. Grouping
determines which observations are combined to form a single geom (e.g.
a line or a boxplot or a polygon). By default, groups are made by all
the categorical variables in the plot. That doesn't work in this
case, so you need to manually specify the grouping -
geom_line(aes(group = 1))

Hadley
